verdict.rationale: Stagehand is a browser-automation framework, not an agent, so an official MCP server applies. Its own docs describe giving a Claude Code agent persistent Stagehand browser tools over MCP/stdio, served by one server process that keeps page state across the run, snapshot, and screenshot tools. A dedicated MCP integration section also exists, and the team mentions its Stagehand MCP server winning Anthropic's MCP hackathon. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the MCP server, and documented setup or compatibility with MCP clients beyond Claude Code.
